description: Every SIGPAC enclosure (recinto) of a Spanish parcel, the CAP land parcel identification system: SIGPAC id, land-use code (TA, OV, VI, FY, PS...) with its name in the requested language, area in hectares, irrigation coefficient, mean slope, altitude, CAP pasture eligibility and region, incidents with their official text and, with include_geometry, the GeoJSON outline. Spain, the Basque Country and Navarre only; other countries answer CNV_COVERAGE. match tells whether the SIGPAC parcel was found by the cadastral reference or under the parcel's point. Source FEGA SIGPAC: cite 'Fuente: FEGA - SIGPAC'. One API call; free when there are no enclosures. If SIGPAC does not answer it returns SIG_001: nothing is charged, retry in a few seconds.

country.description: Optional: ES, PV (Basque Country) or NA (Navarre). Omit to auto-detect.

include_geometry.description: Include the GeoJSON outline of each enclosure (large). Default false.

reference.description: Official Spanish cadastral reference of the parcel or unit

name: get_parcel_sigpac
title: Get Parcel SIGPAC Enclosures
